---
name: Setup toolchain
description: Installs the language toolchain and restores the build cache.

inputs:
  version:
    description: Toolchain version to install.
    required: true

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ inputs.version }}
    - uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/build
        key: build-${{ inputs.version }}
    - run: echo "Installed ${{ inputs.version }}"
      shell: bash

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
